reason: I am losing waiters and my tables are slow on busy nights, so the pain is real. But Sora is a company with no restaurants live yet, and I would be their guinea pig on a Friday night when I cannot afford a slow service.
objection: Who has actually used this? I have no restaurant I can call and ask whether it works, and my older regulars will still want a waiter and a paper menu.
would_change_my_mind: A working pilot in a restaurant like mine, with a named owner I can phone, showing that tables turn faster and the kitchen screen does not drop orders, ideally with a free trial month.
